findings.CURRENT_BEHAVIOR: Role change/remove controls are not fully disabled during pending mutation; feedback is mainly toast-based.

findings.USER_IMPACT: Repeated clicks can produce confusing or duplicate requests.
findings.SECURITY_IMPACT: No privilege escalation found; duplicate authorized mutation risk only.
findings.PRODUCTION_IMPACT: Direct reliability risk in assignment operations.
